label: ACCEPT
reason: Forms wrap labels and messages in _l() (RestoreForm in restore.py, ConditionFormRow in conditions/form.py, RestockSettingsForm, SingleTag). TimeDurationForm (forms.py:181) does have user-visible text: ScheduleLimitDaySubForm renders it with LabelAfterInputTableWidget, which outputs subfield.label (WTForms' default 'Hours'/'Minutes'), shown via render_nolabel_field in _helpers.html, while sibling TimeBetweenCheckForm writes _l('Hours')/_l('Minutes'), which the .po files translate. So it lacks no need and is an i18n mistake, not incidental. setup.cfg holds only Babel config and no linter checks this, so it is not TRIVIAL.
